dataset: Pulmonary lobes and venous branches — source-derived placement
license: Mixed: CC BY-SA 4.0 aggregate; selected inner-ear and kidney assets carry non-commercial source terms
attribution: Z-Anatomy - The libre 3D atlas of anatomy; BodyParts3D - The Database Center for Life Science; additional model-specific credits in ATTRIBUTION.txt and meshes.json
modifications: Converted official FBX to independent named Draco GLB structures; removed annotation-helper geometry; applied FBX hierarchy transforms and converted centimetres to metres; 18-bit position quantization. Mirrored transform winding corrected. No anatomical meshes invented. Original FBX Tendon material faces restored as scalar masks; optional 1.5 mm display feather remains inside authored tendon faces. Original geometry, identifiers and bounds retained. Source-authored Tendon boundary interpolation repaired with planar edge midpoint/face centroid display subdivisions. Original anatomical surfaces and source IDs retained; render tessellation is not additional anatomical detail. Cool off-white nonmetal display material, roughness 0.52, and per-mesh inside-boundary feather capped at 3 mm.

coordinates.sourceToApp: Z-Anatomy original source frame plus the same 8 mm superior translation used by the cardiac block.

limitations: Five original lung lobe surfaces and sixteen named pulmonary venous branch surfaces only; alveolar and capillary networks are not modeled.
No donor surface is deformed or welded to the existing thoracic model.

subset.modifications: Original compressed geometry, attributes and materials retained; source nodes renamed and translated 8 mm superiorly.
